summary: SiteDocument is a data object linked to a Site, used to represent documents related to a particular site. It is implemented as a C# class with ID and SiteID fields. SiteDocument is primarily an entity definition used in the data layer.
purpose: Provide a structured representation of a document associated with a site for retrieval, display, or manipulation within the application.
system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are instantiated with ID and SiteID.
Used as part of a document retrieval or association functionality.
content_gaps: No explicit workflow, business rules, or validation logic described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a UI and workflow for staff administrators to view login history, error/warning panels, and filter/view student employment applications by site, discipline, and date. It includes multiple validators, dropdowns, and a grid view for applications.
purpose: Enable staff administrators to filter and review student employment applications, view login history, and handle errors or warnings.

workflows.name: Filter/View Employment Applications
steps: Select Site and Discipline using dropdowns.
Validate inputs (required fields, date format, logical order).

business_rules: Start Date and End Date are required.
Start Date must be before End Date.
Date inputs must match expected format.
validations: CustomValidator to ensure EndDate is after StartDate.
conditions: chkShowWithdrawn controls inclusion of withdrawn applications.
Page shows login history if available.
system_behavior: Error/Warning panels are shown for relevant conditions.
Dropdowns are populated from relevant lists.
content_gaps: No detailed business process mapping for status transitions.

summary: ServiceCode is a structured data entity for service codes, with fields for code, description, category, notes, and sort order. Supports multi-language display and is used for database retrieval and UI listing.
purpose: To define and retrieve structured codes related to services, enabling categorization and sorting in applications.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Localize Name and Notes based on session language settings.

business_rules: If session is in alternate language mode, use NameAlt and NotesAlt instead of Name and Notes.
conditions: Session language mode alters output fields.
system_behavior: Supports retrieval of all codes, codes by course, or codes by timetable.
content_gaps: No explicit validation, no error handling documented.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profiles, including actions, user info, agency details, and formatted outputs for UI display. Includes logic for language localization and staff/admin attribution in change logs.
purpose: Audit and display history of edits and actions on site profiles for traceability and review.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Query history for a given SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Retrieve and display formatted audit entries.
Localize fields based on session language.

business_rules: If user is not sysadmin and IDs do not match, attribute action to support team.

calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: Combines agency and user initials.
conditions: If Phone is not empty, append phone info to tooltip.
system_behavior: Tracks and formats audit log entries.
Supports UI tooltip and quick display.

steps: Extract file details for EmailPopupDocument objects.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents a batch of expenses for a department, including logic for CRUD operations and formatted display. Used for departmental accounting and expense tracking.

steps: Return list of batches for last year.

purpose: Provide detailed cost centre information for placements, used in accounting, reporting, and business intelligence.

workflows.name: Get CostCentre Records
steps: Query PlacementCostCentre procedure with relevant filters.
Read list of CostCentreRecord for reporting.

conditions: Optional filtering by agencies, disciplines, sites, destinations, services, and PR status.
system_behavior: Aggregates cost centre placement data for reporting.
content_gaps: Business rules for cost-centre assignment and aggregation not detailed.

summary: TimetableAssessments enables management of assessments tied to student placement timetables. Includes logic for assessor, subject, assessment type/template, and business validations like maximums and supervisor/instructor handling. Supports add/edit/delete, optional sections, and view permission toggles.
purpose: To create, modify, and validate assessments for student placement timetables, ensuring proper workflow and business rules.

workflows.name: Manage Timetable Assessments
steps: Validate maximum and interim/final assessment business rules.

business_rules: Screen is editable if not ViewOnly and user is System Administrator or Placement Coordinator + Local Administrator.
Interim assessments must have corresponding final assessments.
Supervisors and instructors cannot overlap assessments.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator and CompareValidator for open/close days, view until days, and assessment template.
CustomValidator on close days to ensure date is after placement start/end.
Error display if interim assessment without final, or instructor/supervisor overlap, or maximum exceeded.
conditions: UI visibility toggled based on rotations existence and data presence.
system_behavior: Shows/hides UI elements based on context.
Displays errors/warnings for business validation failures.
exceptions: Validation errors for dates, maximums, interim/final, instructor/supervisor conflicts.
content_gaps: No explicit mapping of assessment workflow to business outcomes; detailed actor roles for each workflow step missing.
